answers.question: Kumla (`740000192`): withheld: OSM joins no footway to the platforms and tags no entrance
answers.answer: Partly. Station building is on Stationsgatan (west side of the railway, address Stationsgatan 9); Jernhusen says there is an accessible entrance but not where. OSM has a tunnel (w303713042) tagged as reaching platforms 1 and 2 with a lift (n10020544213) at its platform end and a second lift (n10020544210) plus two stairs on the west side, but no source other than OSM confirms them, and no entrance node position can be sourced. The map stays withheld until OSM gets an entrance and footway joins.
